samples.name: terrain-stony-ground
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate exactly ONE opaque 16x16 logical-pixel RPG terrain tile enlarged as crisp pixel art. Input images 1 and 2 are style references: Kenney Tiny Town and Tiny Farm. Match their simple low-resolution, flat-color pixel style. Meadow grass with several loose grey stones of different sizes. Sparse low stones, not boulders. All four edges plain meadow green. Full bleed square terrain seen directly from above, no perspective, no floating block, no surrounding background, no text. Very limited flat palette: meadow #78B85A, darker grass #579548, mud #99724C, river #5B9CB5, light ripple #9BC6CD, stone #8F9696 and #B6BAB3. Use only the colors relevant to this tile. Every pixel aligns to one strict 16 by 16 grid, uniformly enlarged; no tiny details, gradients, soft edges, noise, shadows, highlights beyond this flat palette. Preserve flat edge colors for tiling.
